record_title: Compact quasinilpotent sum-hyponormal multishifts with rank-one defect
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The construction is sum-hyponormal but not sum-normal, so it does not address the sum-normal-versus-normal question or produce a nonzero quasinilpotent sum-normal tuple. A 2020 paper completely characterizing spherical p-hyponormal two-variable weighted shifts was not fully accessible, leaving a residual prior-coverage risk for the d=2 case.
